qh: 1. दो धनात्मक संख्याओं का LCM उनके HCF का 28 गुना है। यदि उनके LCM और HCF का योग 1740 है और एक संख्या 420 है, तो दूसरी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

e: Passed % = 45%. Student % = 45% - 4% = 41%. So 41% = 154? Re-calc: 154 is (45-4)=41%? Let's check 41% = 154 is not clean. If fail by 26 marks which is 4%, then 4% = 26+154? No. Correct Logic: 45% - 41% = 4% of total. Let Max be M. 0.41M = 154 => M = 154/0.41 ≈ 375.6. Corrected logic for Mains: (45% - 154) = 4% of total => 41% = 154. Total = 154/41 * 100 = 375.6. Option 375 is closest.
